title: What is Claude Code?

body.text: CLI tool that lets Claude work directly in your project
— reading files, editing code, running commands, and doing multi-step work without copy-pasting code back and forth.

example: "Find the bug in src/auth/ and fix it, with tests"

title: Why developers love Claude Code

body.text: — it understands the whole project's context, not just one snippet, so it can solve problems across files.

example: "Refactor the entire authentication system, separating concerns properly"

question: How is Claude Code different from using Claude.ai in the browser?
